articles.title: Moscow: Ukraine launches huge drone attack as election wraps up
articles.description: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds at the capital Moscow, in its largest attack of the war so far, officials said Sunday. articles.title: Putin party retains majority in first vote since 2022 invasion of Ukraine

The election was the first since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. France 24 International affairs editor, Oliver Farry, shares further insights from this election.
